facts: Origin includes some MHCLG-created data; replacement with authoritative sources is ongoing.
2026 Ordnance Survey attribution applies to polygon geometry coordinates.
latitude+longitude query returns entities whose geometry intersects the point.
Spatial query coordinates are WGS84 / EPSG:4326.
UPRN q-search is described as more precise for registered properties.
API has no batch endpoint; one request per property is recommended.
Bulk formats include CSV, JSON, GeoJSON where applicable, and Parquet.
New INSPIRE files are published on the first Sunday of each month.
INSPIRE polygon downloads are listed by local authority as GML.
London Borough of Barnet is listed with a GML download.
London Borough of Enfield is listed with a GML download.
GIS is required to view downloads; OGL conditions apply.
Time Stamped DTM resolutions: 25cm, 50cm, 1m, 2m depending on survey.
DTM uses last-return LIDAR with surface objects removed.
Supply is GeoTIFF raster in 5km zip files.
Heights are metres to ODN and aligned to OS Grid.
Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England at 1m resolution.
2022 composite uses newest best-resolution surveys; resampling uses bilinear interpolation.
Composite supply is 5km GeoTIFF, metres to ODN, OSTN15.
Esri Image Services were replaced by WCS/WMS; WCS provides elevation.
OS Terrain 50 is a 50m-post DTM for broad terrain analysis.
Full tile resupply is annual; update schedule is each July.
Online download is available with no registration.
National tiled supply has 2,858 tiles arranged into 55 folders.
Full GB grid-tile supply is about 157 MB compressed.
TQ is a documented valid OpenData area filter.
redirect + exactly one match returns HTTP 307 via /products/{productId}/downloads.
